descriptionChirho: Noun meaning 'cub, whelp,' specifically a young lion or predatory animal. Used in poetic/prophetic contexts as a metaphor for young warriors or tribal vigor (Gen 49:9; Deut 33:22; Nah 2:12-13; Jer 51:38). The singular construct form (eng: cub-of, spa: cachorro-de, hin: शावक, arb: جَرْوُ, kor: 사자-새끼, swa: mtoto-wa-simba) and plural/suffixed forms (eng: their-cubs, cubs-her, spa: sus-cachorros, hin: शावकों-अपने, arb: جِرَائِهَا, kor: 새끼들, swa: watoto-wao) share the same lexical meaning.
